# Ace editor

Vendored from the `ace-builds` npm package, version **1.44.0**.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/ace-builds/-/ace-builds-1.44.0.tgz

The `src-min-noconflict` distribution is served locally. Modes and themes load on demand. Background workers are disabled by the Files application. Upstream license is included in `LICENSE`.
